technique_notes: The site employs a scroll-triggered background effect where the entire full-bleed background visual transitions between distinct scenes or video segments as the user scrolls down the page, creating a narrative progression. Text content scrolls independently over this dynamic background, while a minimal header and footer remain fixed in the viewport.

The detected 'video-hero' tech suggests the background changes are likely achieved by playing different video segments or scrubbing through a single video based on scroll position, or by swapping out large background images/sections to create a cinematic effect.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the dramatic, scroll-triggered background transformation, which shifts between entirely different visual narratives (e.g., abstract art to cinematic scenes) while the text content scrolls over it. This creates a highly immersive and atmospheric portfolio experience that feels more like an interactive film than a traditional website.
